【原视频简介】
About a year ago, I built and published my first-ever iOS app... while I was still learning SwiftUI. It was a tiny app solving a problem I personally had, but putting it in front of real users taught me more than a pile of practice projects ever could.

In this video, I walk through how I built Lensly, what went wrong before and after launch, and the biggest lessons I learned from the experience. Some of my early shortcuts came back to haunt me, but the experience also gave me the foundation to build much more ambitious apps later.

📱Lensly: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lensly-contact-lens-tracker/id6749588331
